title: Aerial FireSmart checklist (items checkable from above)
disclaimer: Based on FireSmart BC guidance; not an official FireSmart assessment.
sources: FireSmart BC, 'FireSmart BC Begins At Home Guide' (web edition), https://begins-at-home-guide.firesmartbc.ca/
FireSmart BC, 'Home Ignition Zone Self-Assessment' (form 2307-02, PDF modified 2025-06-16), https://firesmartbc.ca/resource/hiz-self-assessment/

zones.label: Immediate Zone (0-1.5 m)
zones.goal: A non-combustible area from the house out to 1.5 m around the home and any attachments.

items.question: Is the 1.5 m strip around the house free of combustibles (plants, shrubs, bark mulch, firewood, stored items)?
items.ok_when: Bare soil, gravel, rock, pavement or short irrigated lawn right against the walls.

items.question: Does the roof covering look fire-rated (metal, asphalt shingle, clay or concrete tile) rather than untreated wood shakes?
items.ok_when: Metal, asphalt or tile roof. Wood shake texture is a concern.

items.question: Are the roof and gutters free of needles, leaves and other debris?
items.ok_when: Clean roof surfaces and valleys; no visible needle or leaf build-up.

items.question: Is the roof free of overhanging tree branches, with no tree crowns touching the house?
items.ok_when: No crowns over or touching the roof.

items.question: Are attached decks, fences and boardwalks non-combustible or separated from the house (e.g. a metal gate where a wooden fence meets the house)?
items.ok_when: No wooden deck, fence or boardwalk joined directly to the house, or it is visibly non-combustible.

zones.label: Intermediate Zone (1.5-10 m)
zones.goal: Low, well-spaced, fire-resistant plants; no conifers, woodpiles or easily ignited fuels.

items.question: Is the zone free of conifers (spruce, fir, pine, cedar, juniper)? Deciduous trees are acceptable.
items.ok_when: No conifers within 10 m of the house.

items.question: Is the zone free of firewood piles and stacked lumber?
items.ok_when: No woodpile within 10 m of the house.

items.question: Are sheds, garages and other outbuildings within 10 m absent (or, if present, do they look built to the same standard as the house)?
items.ok_when: No outbuildings within 10 m, or they look non-combustible.

items.question: Is the zone free of vehicles, RVs, boats, trailers and propane tanks parked or stored next to the house?
Is the ground cover short green grass, gravel or hard surface, rather than tall dry grass, bark mulch or dense shrubs?
items.ok_when: Mown green lawn, gravel or paving.

zones.label: Extended Zone (10-30 m)
zones.goal: Thinned and pruned: conifer crowns at least 3 m apart, branches pruned to 2 m, ladder fuels and woody debris removed.

items.question: Are tree crowns (especially conifers) spaced at least 3 m apart?
items.ok_when: Gaps of 3 m or more between crowns, or few trees.

items.question: Is there a break in the canopy between surrounding forest and the house (no continuous canopy reaching toward the home)?
items.ok_when: Open ground or scattered trees between forest and house.

items.question: Is the zone free of ladder fuels (small conifers and shrubs under taller trees)?
Is the ground free of woody debris, slash piles and fallen trees?
items.ok_when: No slash piles or deadfall visible.

zones.label: 30-100 m
zones.goal: Landscape context. FireSmart BC guidance focuses on 0-30 m; beyond 30 m fuel reduction is a neighbourhood and land-manager effort.

items.question: Is the dominant fuel type low hazard (deciduous trees, irrigated or grazed field, developed land) rather than continuous conifer forest?
items.ok_when: Mostly deciduous, field or developed. Name the dominant fuel type in the reason.

items.question: Is there no continuous forest within 100 m that could carry a crown fire toward the home?
items.ok_when: Forest is absent, patchy or separated from the home by open ground.

items.question: Is the home free of a significant slope below it (fire spreads faster uphill)?
items.ok_when: Flat ground or the home sits below the slope. Use the LiDAR slope facts; imagery alone rarely shows slope.
